current_rule_audit.summary: Fast patch/reuse semantics are contradicted by later all-SHA/all-first-fresh prose, the compiled gate registry remains shadow-only, and current-disk takeover can pass synthetic tests with no owner registry. These contradictions slow builds without improving server execution reliability.

preserved_sections: repeat-safe runner and durable partial return
no host tensor replay and no unauthorized RTL change
replaced_or_removed_sections: unconditional SHA and byte-identity blocking for local transfer
full first-fresh replay after an unchanged gate already passed
append-only accident prose duplicated across active rules

positive_controls: an unrun package patch reuses unaffected PASS receipts and reruns only changed blocking surfaces
the active release command rejects a failed launch/actual-input/state-safety/return gate
a fresh session can recover current roles and pending packages from current disk without historical SHA receipts
negative_controls: record-only transport digest drift does not block release
a stale or missing current owner registry fails takeover readiness
a shadow-only registry cannot satisfy active package release admission
a run-bound or tested package cannot be silently patched in place
claim_boundary: This adjudication authorizes only rule, shared gate, Skill and handoff-control-plane maintenance. It does not mutate a family package, config, numeric asset, workload, RTL, storage state or server state.
